items.title: Joe Williams interviewed by Leslie Gourse, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: Edward was in Turkey when Jack Kennedy was shot and killed. He was doing a tour for the State Department.

ctx.x: And the frozen frame at the end was a picture of Ellington, Woody Herman and I with our arms around each other, and we are laughing you know. But here I was in Ankara, Turkey looking at this. And so the Counsel General came in and sat down with me and had a drink. And I was discussing it with him and he said that Duke was in, Edward was in Turkey when Jack Kennedy was shot and killed. He was doing a tour for the State Department. And he canceled the tour and came back home after that. But I thought about the…
The best ambassadors for our country.
